parts.text: The first reference photo sets the sculpting style, clay finish, lighting and camera framing. The second reference photo is the character: keep the exact same face sculpt and head proportions. Change only what this description says: Photograph of a hand-sculpted stop-motion claymation figure, matte plasticine with fingerprints, tool marks and pressed texture, soft studio lighting, highly detailed, in exactly the style of the reference photos. A grotesque disfigured old man with an oversized bobble head, mottled skin with age spots, small sunken bloodshot eyes in swollen red-rimmed lids, a large ear with a fat hanging lobe, thick neck, hunched broad shoulders, head turned three-quarters toward the viewer's right. Head type: a huge tall lumpy dome skull with dents and bumps, like the master reference, ruddy red-pink clay skin, the hood of his grimy hoodie pulled up over his bald head, framing his face and shadowing his brow, raised grey clay wrinkle ridges on the forehead. No mask: his disfigured face is bare, small sunken bloodshot eyes in swollen red lids, a crooked broken nose and rotten yellow teeth. Wearing a grimy torn hoodie, a worn leather tool belt with rusty tools and pouches, his right fist grips a big rusty meat hook; his LEFT fist tightly grips a heavy sledgehammer by its wooden handle, the hammer resting up on his left shoulder with the iron head behind his shoulder, carried in his hand, not strapped to his back. A cream pressed-clay backdrop with blood-red dripping splatter. FACING: exactly like the first reference photo, his body is in three-quarter view and his head and face are turned about 45 degrees toward the RIGHT side of the image (the viewer's right), nose pointing right; never turned to the left side and never straight on. Three-quarter view from the hips up, whole head, mask and weapons inside the frame with a little space above the head, figure centred, square 1:1 composition. SCALE (the same for every figure in the series): the figure is the same size in the frame as in the first reference photo, the bobble head the same size relative to the body, and weapons true to scale with the hands, never oversized or tiny. Both hands are full and both are tight clenched fists, knuckles toward the camera: the right fist grips the held weapon, the left fist grips the second weapon by its handle as described. Avoid: text, logo, letters, watermark, brand marks, sports team logo, red chevrons or triangles on the mask, full-face goalie mask covering the forehead and eyes, white screaming ghost mask, black hooded robe, pins in a grid, extra fingers, deformed hands, cropped head, photo of a real person, cartoon outline, flat 2D, face turned to the left, mirrored pose, long finger blades, clawed glove with four long knives, red and green striped sweater, brown fedora
